correctness.rationale: Vertex-of-section edge interpolation and tetrahedral Gram identities give ‖x_ij‖²=3-8pq/(p+q)². Its exact ratio criterion is homogeneous in the four height coordinates. The height map is a spherical isometry up to factor 2. Every one of the 6 quadrilateral and 8 triangular sign cones has exact spherical area by triangulation/spherical-excess. Endpoints and threshold, including the 8√3/π quadratic onset, follow algebraically. Embedded reproducibility program passed 7236 exact and structural assertions and 150000 seeded Haar samples. Tests are corroborating; the proof covers infinitely many orientations and r.
